notes: One chart: a single axes frame with one x axis (ticks 0, 20, ..., 100, white vertical gridlines drawn over the bars), one title and one legend. 37 horizontal stacked bars, one per model and interface, in six blocks separated by an empty row with an unlabelled tick: GPT (6 bars), Claude (7), Mistral / Mixtral (4), Llama family incl. medicineLLM and OpenBioLLM (13), Gemini / Gemma (5), Phi (2). The blocks have no printed names. Categories are listed top to bottom; segments run left to right in legend order Correct, 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error, Incorrect; every bar spans 0-100 %.

The share of Correct is printed in a rounded box at the right end of every green segment: these 37 rows are source 'printed' (value = the printed number, label_printed verbatim). The other 185 rows are measured (source 'raster'); a class without a visible segment is 0.0 (78 of them; 107 non-zero).
EOP is drawn in light grey #D3D3D3, the colour of the plot background, so an EOP segment shows as a gap in the bar (e.g. Llama2-7b Poe between 30.7 and 32.7 %). NOP is the darker grey #A9A9A9.

Markers right of the 100 % line (their own legend at the lower left), not data values and not encoded: 'Quantized Model' (pink disc with Q) beside Mistralv2-7b-Q8 Local, Llama2-7b-Q8 Local, Llama2-13b-Q5 Local, Llama3-8b-Q8 Local, Gemma2-9b-Q8 Local, Phi3-3b-Q16 Local, Phi3-14b-Q6 Local; 'Fine-tuned Model' (blue book icon) beside medicineLLM-7b-Q8 Local, OpenBioLLM-8b-Q8 Local.

The semi-transparent legend box lies over the Correct segments of the last three bars (Gemma2-27b Poe, Phi3-3b-Q16 Local, Phi3-14b-Q6 Local) between about 1 and 20 %; the green shows through and no other segment is covered.
Tick labels as printed: 'Claude3-Hiaku Web' is spelled that way in the figure (the API bar reads 'Claude3-Haiku API'); 'Phi3-3b-Q16 Local' is printed with two spaces before 'Local'.

Measured on the PDF's embedded bitmap (page 18, one RGB image 1110 x 1569 px, FlateDecode, 3.06 px per PDF point). x axis fitted on the six tick marks 0-100 (sub-pixel centres 273.92, 429.14, 584.66, 739.96, 895.33, 1050.82 px): 7.769 px per %, 0 % at 273.85 px, max residual 0.09 px = 0.012 %; the five gridlines fall at 20.03, 39.99, 59.99, 80.01 and 99.97 % by that fit. Segment boundaries: colour runs along a row of each bar (three rows per bar agree), the single blended pixel at a boundary split by colour projection; every bar starts green at the axis and its red ends under the 100 % gridline (1050-1051 px, 99.90-100.03 %).

36 of 37 bars lie on a grid of 1/300 (1 count = 0.333 % = 2.59 px): their 105 measured cumulative boundaries deviate from k/3 % by median 0.013 %, max 0.046 % (0.14 count). Raster values of these bars are count/3 rounded to 2 decimals. Counts of 300 as Correct/2OP/EOP/NOP/Error/Incorrect: GPT-3.5 Web 143/3/0/3/0/151; GPT-3.5 API 138/0/0/0/0/162; GPT-4 Web 198/2/0/0/0/100; GPT-4 API 198/0/0/0/0/102; GPT-4o API 221/0/0/0/0/79; GPT-4omini API 168/0/0/0/0/132; Claude3-Hiaku Web 150/2/3/0/0/145; Claude3-Haiku API 151/1/8/1/3/136; Claude3-Sonnet Web 166/0/10/1/0/123; Claude3-Sonnet API 157/0/1/2/0/140; Claude3-Opus Web 197/3/3/2/0/95; Claude3-Opus API 198/1/2/2/1/96; Claude3.5-Sonnet API 222/1/0/0/0/77; Mistralv2-7b Poe 122/0/4/5/0/169; Mistralv2-7b-Q8 Local 112/1/1/6/6/174; Mistral-Large Poe 181/1/2/1/0/115; Mixtral-8x7b Poe 163/0/1/1/0/135; Llama2-7b Poe 92/0/6/0/0/202; Llama2-7b-Q8 Local 91/0/0/0/0/209; medicineLLM-7b-Q8 Local 81/1/1/1/1/215; Llama2-13b Poe 99/0/3/0/0/198; Llama2-13b-Q5 Local not on the grid (see uncertain); Llama2-70b Poe 112/1/13/1/2/171; Llama3-8b Poe 130/0/5/0/0/165; Llama3-8b-Q8 Local 93/1/3/0/1/202; OpenBioLLM-8b-Q8 Local 87/1/0/0/12/200; Llama3-70b Poe 164/0/8/0/0/128; Llama3.1-8b Poe 129/0/1/0/0/170; Llama3.1-70b Poe 175/0/1/0/0/124; Llama3.1-405b Poe 192/0/2/0/0/106; Gemini Web 124/4/8/1/20/143; GeminiAdvanced Web 155/15/5/7/26/92; Gemma2-9b Poe 134/0/6/3/0/157; Gemma2-9b-Q8 Local 136/0/3/1/0/160; Gemma2-27b Poe 150/5/9/3/0/133; Phi3-3b-Q16 Local 128/0/3/0/1/168; Phi3-14b-Q6 Local 146/0/0/0/0/154.

Check of the printed shares: the measured end of each green segment differs from the printed number by at most 0.067 % (mean -0.005 %), and count/3 rounds to the printed number in all 36 bars on the grid.

uncertain: Convention: one panel, kind 'stacked_bar', horizontal, value axis x (range 0-100 %, the scorer's normalisation). One category per bar = the y tick label as printed; series = the legend entry; value = the segment's own length in % (not the cumulative edge); all six classes are written for every bar, 0.0 where no segment is drawn. 37 bars x 6 classes = 222 values: 37 printed (Correct), 185 raster.

One chart or several: the figure is one plot (one axes frame, one x axis with one set of tick labels, one y axis, one title, one legend); the six blocks of bars are separated only by an empty row and have no axes, titles or names of their own, so by the conventions ('one chart per plot with its own axes') it is a single chart. Scorer consequence: a single predicted panel pairs with this one whatever its box; a prediction that splits the figure into its blocks has several panels, each with an IoU under 0.5 against the whole crop, and pairs with none.

Accuracy: axis fit residual <= 0.012 %; boundary positions +/- 0.3 px = +/- 0.04 %, which is an eighth of the 1/300 grid step, so the counts are unambiguous. One boundary (Mistralv2-7b-Q8 Local, NOP | Error at 40.0 %) lies under the white 40 % gridline and is known to +/- 0.5 px only; its count is still unambiguous (120 of 300).

Llama2-13b-Q5 Local is not on the 1/300 grid: its green segment ends at 33.435 % (33.333 would be 0.8 px to the left, eight times the median residual of the other bars) and its label reads '33.4%', not '33.3%'; the Error segment ends at 33.771 %. Both edges fit 100/299 = 33.445 and 101/299 = 33.779 within 0.01 %, i.e. the bar looks like 100 correct, 1 error, 198 incorrect of 299 answers, but the denominator cannot be read from the figure and the paper does not mention it. Recorded: Correct 33.4 (printed), Error 0.34 and Incorrect 66.23 as measured (confidence 0.9; 1/299 and 198/299 would be 0.33 and 66.22).
The printed shares have one decimal, so a printed Correct value differs from count/3 by up to 0.033 % and a bar's six values sum to 100 +/- 0.04 (largest deviation 0.04).
Not encoded: the 'Quantized Model' / 'Fine-tuned Model' markers beside nine bars (listed in the panel notes) and the grouping of the bars into six unnamed blocks.
The axes frame runs on to about 106 % in a slightly lighter grey to make room for the markers; there is no tick beyond 100 and the axis range is given as 0-100.

Scorer hazard (scoring.py pairs rows whose labels are within a Levenshtein distance of 0.2 of the longer, first fit): 21 pairs of tick labels count as the same label, e.g. 'GPT-4 API' / 'GPT-4o API', 'Claude3-Sonnet Web' / 'Claude3-Sonnet API' / 'Claude3.5-Sonnet API', 'Claude3-Opus Web' / 'Claude3-Opus API', most of the Llama '... Poe' labels among each other, 'Gemma2-9b Poe' / 'Gemma2-27b Poe', 'Phi3-3b-Q16 Local' / 'Phi3-14b-Q6 Local'. Rows here are in figure order (bars top to bottom, legend order within a bar); a prediction in another order, or one that leaves out a bar, can be paired with a neighbouring model's bar. Tried with scoring.score_figure on this file's own values: in figure order 222 of 222 rows pair and hit; with the rows shuffled 212 pair and 188 are within 0.02; in reverse order 204 pair and 173 are within 0.02. The six series names do not collide.

Agreement with the paper's text (abstract and p. 17; the paper has no table of these values): GPT-4o 73.7 %, Claude3.5-Sonnet 74.0 %, GPT-4 and Claude3-Opus 66.0 %, Mistral-Large 60.3 %, Llama3.1-405b 64 %, Llama3.1-70b 58.3 %, Mixtral-8x7b 54.3 %, Phi3-14b-Q6 48.7 %, Llama3-8b 43.3 % vs 31 % quantized, Llama2-7b 30.7 % vs 30.3 %, Mistralv2-7b 40.7 % and 37.3 %, Gemma2-9b 44.7 % vs 45.3 %, OpenBioLLM 29 %, medicineLLM 27 % all equal the printed shares. The text states only Correct shares; the other five classes rest on the measurement alone. The text's 11,100 question-answers = 37 models x 300 questions.
